<function name="GetTimeEnemyLastReacquired" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns <page>Global.CurTime</page> based time since the enemy was reacquired, meaning it is currently in Line of Sight of the NPC.
	</description>
	<added>2022.06.08</added>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="enemy" type="Entity" default="nil">The enemy to test. Defaults to currently active enemy (<page>NPC:GetEnemy</page>)</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Time enemy was last reacquired.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
